notes.title: #1 『Dig into UNDERGROUNDED』
notes.notes: [h3][b]Hi, everyone! It's time to Dig into UNDERGROUNDED![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]In this corner, we'll be diving deep into some of the historical and cultural tidbits from the world of UNDERGROUNDED.[/p][p]Maybe, after reading this, you'll see the game's world in a whole new light![/p][p]For our first digging session, instead of looking at the underground world Scott explores, we'll take a peek at what comes before that... That's right, the bustling streets and stations of Manhattan![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101927/001e2c5ab0183045e90d375a85a799caf1da271d.jpg"][/img]Here's the heart of the city that you start the game in. Speaking of hearts, it's also where Scott's heart gets broken. Ouch.[/p][p]But let's forget about that and focus on how energetic the place is. The city just feels alive![/p][p]This street corner was inspired by Times Square 42nd Street Station, and City Hall Station. [/p][p]If you look closely, you can see a deli, some glittering Broadway ads, and more NYC goodness.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Now, Scott drops his ring down a storm drain. To chase after it, he has to head underground, into the subway station.[/p][p]The first thing he sees there s a colorful mural. The real Manhattan subway is full of art like this. So much so that it feels like being in a museum while you're commuting.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101927/aba9d33bfe1e0b276b3ca090db00ba231b722130.png"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/Sp87z86dKU4?si=N7VELJUVAhyy123k"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Check out all the posters plastered on the walls. [/p][p]One of them talks about a man who's lost everything and has to fight to reclaim it... Wait, that kind of sounds like Scott's story, doesn't it?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101927/b1d93dc30c5de550674afb34f886ec03e9523575.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Then there's this weirdly poetic ad for an energy drink. It talks about wanting to go back home, but also about trying again... As it turns out, there's a real-life inspiration for this too.[/p][p]It's based on a poem you can spot between the 42nd Street Port Authority and Times Square stations. The verses are scattered across the ceiling, catching the eye of weary commuters and giving them a small boost of courage, as if the station was cheering them on.[/p][p]In UNDERGROUNDED, we've tried to squeeze that very same feeling into one small poster.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101927/066571d23c860ed53c0ec5ba5b2f46af90a03df9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]To reach the platform and keep searching for the ring, Scott has to pass through a ticket gate. And for that, he needs a metro card. But here's something you might not know. Those metro cards? They're going to be phased out by the end of 2025.[/p][p]So, if you play UNDERGROUNDED 10 years from now, you may even feel nostalgic about them.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101927/2f7f93731f83dac14b59586f647e425d3697f87a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In Japan, our train stations ticket gates automatically flap open. But in NYC, you're as likely to see an actual turnstile. We've redesigned them a bit for the game, but in real life, those things can be as tall as a person.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101927/3759f1c72d9b4b3eb821ee876038665ed40beae2.jpg"][/img]Scott finally makes it down to the platform, but there's no sign of his ring.[/p][p]Next time, we'll dive into the underground tunnels and beyond, with more fun facts to discover. See you then![/p][p] [/p][h3][b]《"Where are you today, Scott?"》[/b][/h3][p]He reached the platform, but the ring is nowhere in sight. There's only one choice left: exploring further underground![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101927/c22809c8a9ac6ccb1ba18e3f8e2c40cfa41504be.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: "UNDERGROUNDED" Demo Streaming
notes.notes: [p]Scott, a young man from Manhattan, finally pops the question to his girlfriend... who promptly says "no."[/p][p]He's so dejected that he accidentally drops the ring he used to propose into a storm drain.[/p][p][/p][p]The ring keeps falling deeper and deeper underground. It falls down into the sewers, then further down into... a movie theater?[/p][p]Wait, is that a jet plane? Huh? Why are we in the Old West now? What are cowboys doing underground?[/p][p][/p][p]Turns out that deep below Manhattan there's an underground dungeon where America's past lives on![/p][p]Will Scott be able to traverse it far enough to find his ring?[/p]

notes.title: 【修正済】現在確認されている不具合と今後の対応について
notes.notes: [p]『UNDERGROUNDED』の体験版を遊んでいただきありがとうございます！[/p][p]現在確認できている不具合についてお知らせいたします。[/p][p][b]【2025年6月6日追記】：本不具合について、修正完了いたしました[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]◆不具合の内容[/b][/h3][p]高リフレッシュレートのモニターをしている場合、[/p][p]ゲーム内ゲーム「THUNDERBIRD」にて、プレイヤーの左右移動が極端に遅くなることがある。[/p][p][/p][p]不具合が修正されるまでの一時的な対策にはなりますが、[/p][p]「モニターのリフレッシュレートを下げる（60Hzなど）」[/p][p]ことで症状が改善されることを確認しております。[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]◆対応について[/b][/h3][p]近日中に修正のアップデートを予定しております。[/p][p][b]※6月6日にアップデートを実施いたしました。[/b][/p][p][/p][p]ご迷惑をおかけいたしますが、[/p][p]アップデートが完了するまでの間は、上記対応をお試しいただけますと幸いです。[/p][p][/p][p]引き続き、『UNDERGROUNDED』を[/p][p]よろしくお願いいたします。[/p]

notes.title: The UNDERGROUNDED demo is out!
notes.notes:
We've released a demo for UNDERGROUNDED!
It lets you play levels 0 to 2.

We have threads where you can leave us comments and report bugs, so let you know what you think!
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3076910/discussions/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3076910/discussions/[/url]

(And if you could wishlist UNDERGROUNDED, that'd be great!)

In case you forgot the controls:
<Keyboard>
Confirm: X / Cancel: Z / Use Item: C / Change Item: Q, E / Open Menu: ESC / Call Canary: V

<PlayStation>
Confirm: ✕ / Cancel: 〇 / Use Item: ▢ / Change Item: L1, R1 / Open Menu: Options / Call Canary: △

<XBox>
Confirm: A / Cancel: B / Use Item: X / Change Item: LT, RT / Open Menu: Start / Call Canary: Y
